title: [Bug Report] Spinner Status Words feel unprofessional and dismissive
body:
**Bug Description**
Current Behavior
While Claude Code is processing requests, the spinner displays random whimsical words like "Flibbertigibbeting", "Wibbling", "Smooshing", "Honking", "Noodling", "Combobulating", "Clauding", etc.
Problem
These made-up and humorous status words feel unprofessional and dismissive, especially in the context of serious production work. When Claude Code is **struggling with a task — producing incorrect fixes, looping on broken solutions** — seeing "Wibbling..." or "Booping..." adds insult to injury. It undermines trust in the tool.
For developers working under pressure on complex production systems (e.g., Teams bot integrations, Azure deployments, real-time media SDKs), the cute tone is a mismatch with the seriousness of the work.

**Environment Info**
- Platform: darwin
- Terminal: webstorm
- Version: 2.1.32
- Feedback ID: 81b37cfb-12a2-4388-bf6e-f07787209842

**Errors**
```json
[{"error":"Error: NON-FATAL: Lock acquisition failed for /Users/doron/.local/share/claude/versions/2.1.32 (expected in multi-process scenarios)\n    at CFR (/$bunfs/root/claude:3667:2098)\n    at KkA (/$bunfs/root/claude:3667:1209)\n    at processTicksAndRejections (native:7:39)","timestamp":"2026-02-05T19:33:55.702Z"}]
```
author: doronneumann

top_comments.author: lrvl
top_comments.body: It’s great to care about the details, but let’s keep some perspective—it’s just a status message, not a system failure. Keeps the vibes light on the UI 😀🤗

top_comments.author: jmadren
top_comments.body:
> It’s great to care about the details, but let’s keep some perspective—it’s just a status message, not a system failure. Keeps the vibes light on the UI 😀🤗

What some may call "light vibes", others call distracting and unprofessional. Especially since it animates - drawing your attention when there's literally "nothing to see".

top_comments.body: Agreed. Duplicate of https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/issues/20879. Please 👍 his opening post, I have.
